questions.q: A pair sold 7 and 18 units in two sale lines of the same month. What is its clipped monthly target?
questions.why: The monthly sum is 25. Clip to 20.

questions.q: Why merge on date_block_num + lag instead of using shift?
options: Months without a row would shift wrongly with row-based shift

questions.q: Which feature is leakage when predicting month b?
options: Mean target of all items in month b
why: Correct: it includes the target month.

questions.q: Scenario: 40% of test pairs have no sales history. What do you do?
options: Analyse them separately and add item, category or shop level features

questions.q: The metric clips the true target to [0, 20]. What should your predictions be?

why: Correct: 0 is January 2013, so 33 is October 2015.

questions.q: Scenario: one sale line has item_cnt_day = 2169. What do you do?
options: Remove or cap it as an outlier before training
